summary: The shared chart glyph table is a 5x5 (25-char) bitmap authored at 23 chars, indexed with stride 5. Two characters short = two mid-string deletions = every row below each cut sheared one pixel left. Fixed once in a new shared module tools/lib/chart-font.mjs, authored as validated 5-char rows so the defect class cannot recur silently.
next_step: Wire the seven editable chart tools to the shared module; hand off the two owned by live pieces; enumerate damage; regenerate BOOK/POOK figure; delete-the-fix.

the_defect.where: a copy-pasted FONT/GLYPH literal in each chart tool
the_defect.mechanism: glyph strings are 23 characters; text() indexes bits[j * 5 + i]. Width and stride disagree, so each missing character deletes mid-string and shifts every row below it one pixel left. 3-4 of 5 rows wrong per glyph. Not a truncated tail.
the_defect.fix: tools/lib/chart-font.mjs — glyphs authored as five explicit 5-character rows, compiled at load, compile() throws on any row that is not 5 wide or any glyph that is not 5 rows.
the_defect.provenance: 35 of 52 glyphs are a provable two-character-deletion restoration of the shipped string; 17 re-authored for legibility. node tools/lib/chart-font.mjs --provenance recomputes the split.
